data.name: Kareema
data.gender_notes: Kareema is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kareema refers to a gentle and soft heart, symbolizing love and kindness. The name Kareema carries the meaning “Tender and compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kareema usually hope their child will grow to embody tender and compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Quranic context, Kareema means a gentle and merciful servant of Allah.
data.etymology: Kareema belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tender and compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kareema total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: كريمة
in_arabic.meaning: كريمة تعني كثيرة العطاء و السخاء و الكرم
in_arabic.long_meaning: كريمة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و تعني كثيرة العطاء و السخاء و الكرم. و هي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محببة في الإسلام. و قد ورد ذكر الكرم في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'و إذا حييتُم فكأنما حييتُم جميع الناس' (المائدة: 32)، و هذا يدل على عظيم قيمة الكرم في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: کریما
in_urdu.meaning: کریما کا مطلب ہے بہت زیادہ دینے والی، سخاوت کرنے والی، اور کریم
in_urdu.long_meaning: کریما ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے بہت زیادہ دینے والی، سخاوت کرنے والی، اور کریم۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے۔ اس نام کی لفظی معنیٰ عربی زبان میں 'کریم' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'عظیم' یا 'بخشنے والا'۔

in_hindi.name: करीमा
in_hindi.meaning: करीमा का अर्थ है बहुत अधिक देने वाली, उदार, और दयालु
in_hindi.long_meaning: करीमा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है बहुत अधिक देने वाली, उदार, और दयालु। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इसका उल्लेख इस्लामी परंपरा में भी मिलता है। करीमा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा में 'करीम' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है 'उदार' या 'दयालु'।

in_pashto.name: کریمہ
in_pashto.meaning: کریمہ د ډیرو ورکولو معنی لري، د سخاوت کولو، او کریم
in_pashto.long_meaning: کریمہ یو مونث نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې نه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د ډیرو ورکولو، سخاوت کولو، او کریم معنی لري. دا نوم د افغانستان په پښتنو ټولنو کې ډیر مشهور دی او د اسلامي دود په کتابونو کې يې هم ذکر شوی دی.

in_english.name: Kareema
in_english.long_meaning: Kareema is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'generous', 'noble', and 'kind-hearted'. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'K-R-M', which conveys the idea of generosity, nobility, and kindness. In Islamic tradition, the name Kareema is associated with positive qualities such as charity, compassion, and benevolence. The name has been used across various Muslim cultures and is often chosen for its beautiful meaning and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kareema holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world. It is derived from the Arabic language, and is commonly used among Muslim communities. In various parts of the Middle East, South and Central Asia, and North Africa, it is often used as a given name for girls. The gentle and soft connotation of the term evokes feelings of grace, femininity, and loveliness, making it an excellent choice for a child.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kareema is deeply rooted in Islamic values of compassion, kindness, and mercy. As mentioned earlier, the term denotes a soft and gentle heart, which reflects the spiritually desirable qualities of kindness and understanding. The name is reminiscent of the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) instructions to his followers to treat others with compassion, kindness, and mercy. Moreover, this name may serve as a reminder to the bearer to strive to develop a kind and gentle heart, reflecting the beautiful attributes of Allah (swt) and inspiring others to do the same.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Tender and compassionate" symbolizes Kareema refers to a gentle and soft heart, symbolizing love and kindness.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kareema serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of tender and compassionate.

historical_references.reference: Kareema bint Jameel was a noblewoman from the Banu Asad tribe in pre-Islamic Arabia. She is known for her beauty and generosity.
